record.paper_title: Topological Open Problems in the Geometry of Banach Spaces
record.context_brief: Approximating the identity via duality-map compositions
record.original_question: Let X be a Banach space with a Fréchet differentiable norm, let S_X be its unit sphere, and let δ:S_X→X* be the duality map satisfying δ(x)(x)=1=||x|| for every x in S_X. Can one construct a sequence of σ-continuous maps φ_p:X*→X, continuous for the norm topologies in the σ-continuous sense, such that the maps φ_p∘δ approximate the identity map on S_X, for example by ensuring that for every x∈S_X, 0 lies in the weak closure of {(Id−φ_p)^n(x): n,p∈N}?

Question 6. Let X be a Banach space with a Fréchet differentiable norm. Is it possible to construct a sequence of σ-continuous maps for the norm topologies φp : X∗ → X such that the sequence {φp ◦ δ : p ∈ N} will provide a way to approximate the identity map on the unit sphere of X? For instance, in such a way that: 0 ∈ {(Id − φp)n(x) : n, p ∈ N} σ(X,X∗) for every x ∈ SX (see Theorem 3).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a (real) Banach space whose norm $\|\cdot\|$ is Fréchet differentiable on $X\setminus\{0\}$, and let $S_X=\{x\in X:\|x\|=1\}$ denote its unit sphere. Because the norm is Fréchet differentiable, for every $x\in S_X$ there is a unique functional $\delta(x)\in X^*$ with $\|\delta(x)\|=1$ and $\delta(x)(x)=1$; the map $\delta:S_X\to X^*$ is called the duality map. A map $\varphi:X^*\to X$ is called $\sigma$-continuous for the norm topologies if its domain can be written as a countable union of sets on each of which $\varphi$ is norm-to-norm continuous.

Question: Does there exist a sequence $\{\varphi_p:X^*\to X\}_{p\in\mathbb{N}}$ of $\sigma$-continuous maps (for the norm topologies) such that the compositions $\varphi_p\circ\delta:S_X\to X$ approximate the identity map on $S_X$ in the following sense:
$$0\;\in\;\overline{\{(\mathrm{Id}-\varphi_p)^n(x): n,p\in\mathbb{N}\}}^{\,\sigma(X,X^*)}\quad\text{for every }x\in S_X,$$
where the closure is taken with respect to the weak topology $\sigma(X,X^*)$ on $X$?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem in the geometry of Banach spaces concerning approximation of the identity on the unit sphere via compositions with the duality map. Web searches show related results on σ-continuity properties of duality maps for Fréchet-differentiable norms (e.g., σ-slicely continuous decompositions), but no source reporting a resolution of this specific approximation question was found.

status_evidence.title: Weak continuity of the normalized duality map
status_evidence.snippet: Studies continuity properties of the duality map in Banach spaces with smoothness assumptions.
status_evidence.claim: Related continuity questions about the duality map remain an active research topic, but the specific approximation question is not reported as solved.

status_evidence.title: Fréchet Differentiable Norm and LUR Renormings
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses Fréchet differentiability of norms, renormings, and σ-continuity-type properties of duality maps.
status_evidence.claim: σ-continuity properties of the duality map are studied, but no resolution of the approximation-of-identity question is given.
